train_halide_supervisor: train the HalideSupervisor model on a batch of expression simplification data
eval_halide_supervisor: evaluate the HalideSupervisor model on expression simplification data with multiprocessing support
train_jsp_supervisor: train the jspSupervisor model on a batch of job scheduling data

save_supervisor_model: save the Supervisor model checkpoint to disk and prune old checkpoints
